newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: NEDCOR NAMES LIEBENBERG NEW CHAIRMAN.
newsitem.headline: NEDCOR NAMES LIEBENBERG NEW CHAIRMAN.

text.p: South Africa's Nedcor Ltd on Wednesday named Chris Liebenberg as its new chairman, replacing John Maree who is retiring.
Liebenberg was the bank's chief executive betwen 1990 and 1994, until he left to take up the government post of finance minister.
Liebenberg served in the government until April, 1996, when he stepped down and rejoined Nedcor as deputy chairman.
He already holds the post of chairman at chemical firm Hoechst South Africa Ltd and is a director of Mutual and Federal Insurance Co Ltd.
